caption: The drawing is in black and white and depicts a metal cauldron hanging from a chain. The cauldron is round and rests on three short legs. It has a thick, curved carrying handle attached at two points to the rim. Inside the cauldron, there is a stick or stirring rod protruding out at an angle. The cauldron is suspended by a twisted metal rope or chain, which is connected to a pair of interlinked metal rings at the top. The objects are centered within a simple square frame drawn on a plain background. There are no other objects or decorations present in the composition.
title: Kettle with Spoon
